_notes: Fine-tuned run: same perturbations as config.json, read with the 1 bp fine-tuned ATAC head (linear probe on 1 bp Tn5 insertion tracks, 4 conditions x cardiomyocyte/fibroblast).
paths.weights must be the base the head was trained on (fold 3); ag_lib checks the weights hash stored in the checkpoint.
CM / FB: fine-tuned ATAC averaged over YS, MAS, MAE, YE (columns atac_*), each condition also as atac_*_<cond> (ft_split), plus the built-in RNA of the same fold-3 model.
CM_builtin / FB_builtin: the built-in heart / Patski ATAC heads of the same forward pass, for a like-for-like comparison.
finetuned.checkpoint: frozen copy of the chosen epoch in finetune_data/heads/ (copy it there before a run; 17_ft_evaluate.py --checkpoint overrides it).
